entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I'm just so confused by the website. I have this jersey and I think I need to send it back, but I don't know how.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Oh, sure. The email is hello@example.com. It's the Pro-Weave jersey. I tried it on and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the order here, placed 47 days ago. And you're saying the issue is with the fit of the jersey?
Yes, exactly. I just want to exchange it, but the online portal was so overwhelming. I didn't know if I was past the date or what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just check our policy for you. ... Okay, yes, it looks like standard items like your jersey are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can still do it?
Absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. We can definitely process an exchange for a different size or a full refund, whichever you prefer.
Oh, thank goodness! I would love to just exchange it for the next size up. I really like the jersey, it was just too tight for me.

Not a problem at all. I have initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just print it out, attach it to the package with the original jersey, and drop it off. We'll send out the new size as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
